A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
decreased health care satisfaction in black inner-city patients is associated with increased morbidity and decreased compliance.
the patient satisfaction correlates with medication compliance and blood pressure in our study population.
decreased patient satisfaction with health care correlates with decreased compliance, increased symptoms, and higher blood pressure.
The main takeaway from our work is that
satisfaction is an important factor in compliance, and that it may be possible to improve compliance by increasing satisfaction.
satisfaction is an important determinant of health outcomes and that it is important to measure satisfaction and to understand its determinants.
satisfaction with health care is an independent correlate of medication compliance, blood pressure control and proteinuria in black inner-city patients.
